import base64
import hashlib
import os
import secrets
import urllib.parse


AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV = "AUTH0_DOMAIN"
AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"
AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI_ENV = "AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI"
AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV = "AUTH0_AUDIENCE"
AUTH0_SCOPE_ENV = "AUTH0_SCOPE"


def _b64url_no_pad(data: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")


def _pkce_pair() -> tuple[str, str]:
    verifier = _b64url_no_pad(secrets.token_bytes(32))
    challenge = _b64url_no_pad(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
    return verifier, challenge


def build_authorization_url(state: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    domain = os.environ[AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV].strip()
    client_id = os.environ[AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV].strip()
    redirect_uri = os.environ[AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI_ENV].strip()
    audience = os.getenv(AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV, "").strip()
    scope = os.getenv(AUTH0_SCOPE_ENV, "openid profile email").strip()
    if not state:
        state = _b64url_no_pad(secrets.token_bytes(16))
    verifier, challenge = _pkce_pair()

    params = {
        "response_type": "code",
        "client_id": client_id,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "scope": scope,
        "state": state,
        "code_challenge": challenge,
        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
    }
    if audience:
        params["audience"] = audience

    url = f"https://{domain}/authorize?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
    return url, verifier, state


def main() -> None:
    url, verifier, state = build_authorization_url()
    print(url)
    print(verifier)
    print(state)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import requests


GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"


def exchange_authorization_code(code: str, redirect_uri: str, code_verifier: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"]
    client_secret = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
    payload = {
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "client_id": client_id,
    }
    if code_verifier:
        payload["code_verifier"] = code_verifier
    if client_secret:
        payload["client_secret"] = client_secret
    response = requests.post(
        GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT,
        data=payload,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_OIDC_USERINFO_URL = "https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo"
+
+
+def _env(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    return value if value not in (None, "") else default
+
+
+def fetch_google_profile_claims(access_token: Optional[str] = None, userinfo_url: str = GOOGLE_OIDC_USERINFO_URL) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    token = access_token or _env("GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN")
+    if not token:
+        raise ValueError("Missing Google OAuth access token")
+
+    response = requests.get(
+        userinfo_url,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    claims = response.json()
+    return normalize_google_profile_claims(claims)
+
+
+def normalize_google_profile_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    email = claims.get("email")
+    email_verified = claims.get("email_verified")
+    subject = claims.get("sub")
+    given_name = claims.get("given_name") or claims.get("first_name")
+    family_name = claims.get("family_name") or claims.get("last_name")
+    full_name = claims.get("name")
+    if not full_name and (given_name or family_name):
+        full_name = " ".join(part for part in [given_name, family_name] if part)
+    picture = claims.get("picture")
+    locale = claims.get("locale")
+
+    return {
+        "provider": "google",
+        "subject": subject,
+        "email": email,
+        "email_verified": bool(email_verified) if email_verified is not None else None,
+        "given_name": given_name,
+        "family_name": family_name,
+        "name": full_name,
+        "picture": picture,
+        "locale": locale,
+        "raw": claims,
+    }

+import base64
+import hashlib
+import os
+import secrets
+import urllib.parse
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV = "AUTH0_DOMAIN"
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV = "AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"
+AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI_ENV = "AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI"
+AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV = "AUTH0_AUDIENCE"
+AUTH0_SCOPE_ENV = "AUTH0_SCOPE"
+
+
+def _b64url_no_pad(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
+
+
+def _pkce_pair() -> tuple[str, str]:
+    verifier = _b64url_no_pad(secrets.token_bytes(32))
+    challenge = _b64url_no_pad(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
+    return verifier, challenge
+
+
+def build_authorization_url(state: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+    domain = os.environ[AUTH0_DOMAIN_ENV].strip()
+    client_id = os.environ[AUTH0_CLIENT_ID_ENV].strip()
+    redirect_uri = os.environ[AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI_ENV].strip()
+    audience = os.getenv(AUTH0_AUDIENCE_ENV, "").strip()
+    scope = os.getenv(AUTH0_SCOPE_ENV, "openid profile email").strip()
+    if not state:
+        state = _b64url_no_pad(secrets.token_bytes(16))
+    verifier, challenge = _pkce_pair()
+
+    params = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": client_id,
+        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+        "scope": scope,
+        "state": state,
+        "code_challenge": challenge,
+        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+    }
+    if audience:
+        params["audience"] = audience
+
+    url = f"https://{domain}/authorize?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
+    return url, verifier, state
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    url, verifier, state = build_authorization_url()
+    print(url)
+    print(verifier)
+    print(state)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
